policy: Creative planning presets, not installed renderers. Select a coherent subset or explicitly none; never imply an untested effect/model/editor is operational.

presets.label: Glitter / sparkle dust
presets.appearance: Tiny reflective flecks with restrained highlight twinkle.
presets.route: Reference-guided generation or cleared particle composite.
presets.risk: Strobe, oversized flakes, noisy faces and fake spill.

presets.label: Neon accents / rim glow
presets.appearance: Controlled luminous color around a motivated sign, prop or declared stylized contour.
presets.lightMode: Declare physical emission/spill versus graphic post glow.
presets.route: Generated accepted light states or a capable tracked/relit editor.
presets.risk: Glow halo mistaken for relighting, clipped skin and arbitrary new shadows.

presets.label: Neon trails / ribbons
presets.appearance: One deliberate luminous path following a planned movement.
presets.lightMode: Emissive or graphic stylization, explicitly distinguished.
presets.risk: Lagging tracking, trails through bodies and unreadable action.

presets.label: Golden shiny butterflies
presets.appearance: A small count of coherent golden wings with controlled flutter and path.
presets.lightMode: Reflected gold is not automatically a light source.
presets.risk: Malformed wings, swarms covering faces and unstable scale.

presets.label: Golden butterfly dust / sparkle wake
presets.appearance: Fine golden motes trailing a selected butterfly or revealing a detail.
presets.lightMode: Specify reflective dust or emissive motes and resulting spill.
presets.route: Supported generation or cleared particle composite with occlusion.
presets.risk: Dust replacing the subject, unmotivated glow and abrupt particle births.

presets.label: Sakura petals
presets.appearance: Recognizable soft petals with coherent scale, wind and seasonal context.
presets.route: Reference-guided generation or layered masked petals.
presets.risk: Petal/finger morphs, inconsistent season and foreground face occlusion.

presets.label: Sakura / flower dust
presets.appearance: A restrained pink floral particle veil, distinct from full petals.
presets.lightMode: Normally reflective/transmissive; fantasy emission must be explicit.
presets.route: Supported generation or cleared particle composite.
presets.risk: Confetti noise, snow-like scale, hidden expressions and unexplained emission.

presets.label: Flowers / bloom
presets.appearance: Static floral beauty or a separately planned growth action.
presets.route: Accepted static frames; growth requires its own tested action route.
presets.risk: Static flower evidence incorrectly claimed as demonstrated growth.

presets.label: Fireflies / luminous motes
presets.appearance: Sparse small luminous points with plausible depth and stable paths.
presets.lightMode: Small emission; state whether nearby spill is negligible.
presets.risk: Oversized light pools, exposure pumping and random blinking.

presets.label: Bokeh / restrained bloom
presets.appearance: Optical background softness or controlled bright-region bloom.
presets.lightMode: Optical/post treatment, not a new illuminating object.
presets.route: Camera/render design or tested post process.
presets.risk: Eye detail loss, clipped halos and confusion with physical lighting.

presets.label: Light rays / volumetric shafts
presets.appearance: Motivated shafts through atmosphere with readable source direction.
presets.lightMode: Scattering of an existing source; preserve occlusion.
presets.route: Supported generated light state or capable volumetric/editor route.
presets.risk: Rays through solid shelter, new key direction and flattened contrast.

presets.label: Rain
presets.appearance: Depth-consistent rain with controlled wet/dry boundaries.
presets.route: Existing pilot used in-generation rain; full perception is separately pending.
presets.risk: Rain inside shelter, concealed dry evidence and inconsistent perspective.

presets.label: Wind / moving trees
presets.appearance: Coherent restrained leaf and cloth motion.
presets.lightMode: Stable environmental lighting and grounded shadows.
presets.route: Supported generation or a tested mesh/tracking editor.
presets.risk: Warping trunks/people, contradictory wind and floating contact.

presets.label: Autumn leaves
presets.appearance: Seasonally coherent leaf drift or still ground texture.
presets.route: Reference-guided generation or cleared layered composite.
presets.risk: Incompatible spring/autumn mix, unstable leaf scale and lost faces.
